purpose: Local preparation timeout and reference-prefix reduction; browser validation still required
native_runtime: llama.cpp b11236 CPU, single process, 8 threads
limitations: Development cases only; not clinical validation.
Different engine from wllama 3.6.1; results do not establish browser speed or identical browser accuracy.
One prefix cache reused within each task family; no browser four-slot caching, worker lifecycle, GPU or downloads tested.
The original classifier was restored after all three compact classifier candidates fell below the 38/40 development baseline.

The native baseline missed one device-classification case (Resp LEADS OFF), while previously recorded browser validation passed it. Native results are not a substitute for the production browser gate.
No new end-to-end browser latency, GPU inference, generation text or Windows performance result is available for this patch.

final_configuration.classification: Original system prompt and all 19 original chat examples; original classifier prompt version retained
final_configuration.reference_selection: Original instructions; five of nine original example pairs retained. Fourteen development selections passed in each native compact experiment.
final_configuration.gpu_retry: One CPU retry; does not renew initialization or inference deadline; original failure kept locally

required_before_deployment: All six generated answers under the 45-second inference budget and accepted by the API
